Search summary (Wikipedia): 25 trails, longest 9 km, 14 areas; 41 lifts = 4 gondolas (ropeways probably counted here), 5 quad, 3 triple, 27 pair and 2 single chairlifts. Vintage unclear — may be dated. Skiable area 1.86 km² (acres not stored)
Piste reference data — confirm at source. Only features Piste is confident about are set; everything else is unknown (null), not 'not offered'. The hot-spring village sits at the foot of the slopes

character: The largest ski area in Tohoku, spread over about 14 areas on Mt. Jizo above the Zao Onsen hot-spring village near Yamagata city. Its upper slopes are known for the rime-covered 'snow monster' trees, which non-skiers can also reach by the Zao Ropeway.
learning: Reference, confirm: the lower areas near the village have gentle slopes, and ski schools and rentals operate in the village.
